title: English Advanced Practice Bank – Error Bank, Vocabulary 150+, Cloze Strategy
content:
English Expansion • Paper-2 Extra Weapon

Aa Error Bank – 40 Most-Repeated KEA Errors (Rule + Correction)

• Verb errors: 'One of my friend'✗→friends (one of + plural); 'He is knowing'✗→knows (stative verbs no -ing: know, believe, love, own); 'I am having a car'✗→have; 'Did he went?'✗→go (did + V1); 'He has come yesterday'✗→came (past time word → simple past); 'Since 2010 he works'✗→has been working; 'If I will go'✗→If I go (no will in if-clause); 'He asked me where was I going'✗→where I was going (indirect = statement order); 'Let him to go'✗→go (let + bare infinitive); 'I look forward to meet'✗→to meeting ('to' here is preposition!).
• Noun-Pronoun-Adjective errors: 'Two dozens eggs'✗→dozen (number words fixed after numeral: dozen/hundred/thousand); 'He gave me an advice'✗→a piece of advice; 'The sceneries'✗→scenery; 'My both hands'✗→both my hands; 'He is senior than me'✗→senior to (Latin comparatives + to: senior, junior, superior, inferior, prior); 'more better'✗; 'The two first chapters'✗→first two; 'Myself Ramesh'✗→I am Ramesh; 'One should respect his parents'✗→one's; 'Each of them have'✗→has; 'less students'✗→fewer (countable = fewer); 'He is more intelligent than any student'✗→any other student.
• Preposition-Article-Conjunction errors: 'Married with'✗→married to; 'Discuss about'✗→discuss (transitive – no about; same: attack, resemble, enter, reach); 'Comprises of'✗→comprises; 'Order for'✗→order; 'Reached to home'✗→reached home; 'In the morning of Monday'✗→on the morning; 'Superior from'✗→to; 'Prefer tea more than coffee'✗→prefer tea to coffee; 'a European'✓ (yu-sound = a), 'an hour'✓, 'an MLA'✓ (em-sound), 'a one-rupee note'✓ (wa-sound); 'The Ganga'✓ (rivers take the), 'The Hindu'✓ (newspapers); no article: go to school/bed/church (purpose); 'Not only he is'✗→Not only is he (inversion); 'No sooner he came than'✗→No sooner did he come than; 'Hardly had he gone when'✓ (hardly...when, no sooner...than – pair fixed!).

Aa Vocabulary Power Bank – Synonyms/Antonyms/One-word (Exam Frequency Order)

• High-frequency synonyms: Abandon=ತೊರೆ (desert, forsake); Abundant=ಹೇರಳ (plentiful); Candid=ನಿಷ್ಕಪಟ (frank); Diligent=ಶ್ರಮಶೀಲ (industrious); Eminent=ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತ (distinguished); Feeble=ದುರ್ಬಲ (weak); Gigantic=ಬೃಹತ್ (enormous); Hostile=ವೈರತ್ವದ (unfriendly); Immense=ಅಪಾರ; Jubilant=ಹರ್ಷಭರಿತ; Keen=ತೀವ್ರ ಆಸಕ್ತಿಯ; Lament=ಶೋಕಿಸು (mourn); Meticulous=ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಎಚ್ಚರದ; Notorious=ಕುಖ್ಯಾತ (bad fame – famous ಜೊತೆ ಗೊಂದಲ ಟ್ರ್ಯಾಪ್!); Obsolete=ಬಳಕೆ ತಪ್ಪಿದ (outdated); Prudent=ವಿವೇಕಿ; Quell=ಅಡಗಿಸು (suppress); Rectify=ಸರಿಪಡಿಸು; Sacred=ಪವಿತ್ರ (holy); Tranquil=ಪ್ರಶಾಂತ (calm); Vacant=ಖಾಲಿ; Wrath=ಕೋಪ (fury); Zeal=ಉತ್ಸಾಹ (enthusiasm); Transparent=ಪಾರದರ್ಶಕ; Venture=ಸಾಹಸ.
• Antonym pairs (exam favourites): Optimist×Pessimist; Transparent×Opaque; Ancient×Modern; Artificial×Natural; Barren×Fertile; Bold×Timid; Innocent×Guilty; Knowledge×Ignorance; Victory×Defeat; Permanent×Temporary; Maximum×Minimum; Majority×Minority; Include×Exclude; Import×Export; Superior×Inferior; Flexible×Rigid; Generous×Miserly/Stingy; Humble×Arrogant; Genuine×Fake; Expand×Contract; Accept×Reject; Construct×Demolish; Attract×Repel; Deep×Shallow; Scarce×Abundant; Urban×Rural; Zenith×Nadir (ಶಿಖರ×ಪಾತಾಳ – classic pair).
• One-word substitution (60 core): ಜನರ ಆಡಳಿತ=Democracy; ಒಬ್ಬನ ಆಡಳಿತ=Autocracy/Monarchy; ಶ್ರೀಮಂತರ ಆಡಳಿತ=Plutocracy; ದೇವರಿಲ್ಲವೆನ್ನುವವ=Atheist; ದೇವರಿದ್ದಾನೆನ್ನುವವ=Theist; ಮಾಂಸ ತಿನ್ನದವ=Vegetarian; ಎಲ್ಲ ತಿನ್ನುವ=Omnivorous; ಸ್ವಂತ ಜೀವನಚರಿತ್ರೆ=Autobiography; ಇನ್ನೊಬ್ಬರ ಜೀವನಚರಿತ್ರೆ=Biography; ಕೈಬರಹ ಪ್ರತಿ=Manuscript; ಅನೇಕ ಭಾಷೆ ಬಲ್ಲವ=Polyglot; ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಬಲ್ಲವ=Omniscient; ಸರ್ವವ್ಯಾಪಿ=Omnipresent; ಸರ್ವಶಕ್ತ=Omnipotent; ಜನದ್ವೇಷಿ=Misanthrope; ಮಾನವಪ್ರೇಮಿ=Philanthropist; ಮಹಿಳಾದ್ವೇಷಿ=Misogynist; 100 ವರ್ಷ=Century; 100 ವರ್ಷದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ=Centenarian; 10 ವರ್ಷ=Decade; 1000 ವರ್ಷ=Millennium; ಗುಣಪಡಿಸಲಾಗದ=Incurable; ಓದಲಾಗದ (ಬರಹ)=Illegible; ತಪ್ಪಿಸಲಾಗದ=Inevitable; ಕೇಳಿಸದಷ್ಟು ಮೆಲು=Inaudible; ನಂಬಲಾಗದ=Incredible; ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗದ=Inexplicable; ಮರಣಾನಂತರ ಪ್ರಕಟ=Posthumous; ಒಂದೇ ಕಾಲದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳು=Contemporaries; ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ=Zoology; ಪಕ್ಷಿ=Ornithology; ಹವಾಮಾನ=Meteorology; ನಕ್ಷತ್ರ/ಖಗೋಳ=Astronomy; ಭೂಕಂಪ=Seismology; ಕೀಟ=Entomology.

★ Exam Key Points

• Trap flash: senior/junior + TO (not than); no sooner...THAN; hardly...WHEN; look forward to + ING; discuss (no about); married TO; fewer=countable; notorious=bad famous.
• One-word flash: Polyglot=ಬಹುಭಾಷಿ; Posthumous=ಮರಣಾನಂತರ; Inevitable=ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯ; Zenith×Nadir; Omniscient=ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞ.

◆ ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಷ್ ಸರಪಳಿ

V1 after did/modal◆to+ing look forward◆than no sooner◆when hardly◆to senior/junior
